question: What power does the goddess hold to delight even the seven sages journeying to desired abodes?
premises: The seven sages travel to desired abodes.
Even these sages experience delight through meeting her.
Her presence causes delight in those who seek higher realms.
inference: The goddess possesses a delight-giving power that affects even accomplished sages.
plain_english: Even the seven sages, going to their desired abodes, are delighted by meeting her.
